subject: Re: MAP — Recast of commitment timeline and escalation path
messages:
From: Claudia Rios <claudia.rios@kphealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@kphealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — commitment timing concern

Marcus —

Quick note after today's internal review: procurement is pushing the internal go/no-go to the week of Oct 4. They cited SOC evidence completeness and a vendor risk hold as the blocking items. That moves our previously agreed acceptance date out by ~3 weeks.

Can Redwood provide an updated MAP that shows a compressed acceptance path (targeting the original window) and a clear list of what we can commit to for SOC artifact delivery and rollout milestones? Procurement asked for a single-page risk register they can use in their executive packet.

Thanks,
Claudia

Claudia Rios
Director, Strategic Programs — KP Health
claudia.rios@kphealth.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Rios <claudia.rios@kphealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — commitment timing concern

Hi Claudia —

Appreciate the heads up. I'm attaching an updated MAP (MAP_v2.xlsx) and a one-page risk register summary for procurement. High level:

- SOC artifacts: we can certify delivery of the SOC2 evidence summary within 6 business days (attached PDF), and provide a timeboxed audit log export by Sept 25.
- Acceptance window: we propose a two-track acceptance approach — a soft-accept for feature parity by Sept 27 and a hard-accept after a 7-day production verification window ending Oct 4. This keeps the original hard-accept date in scope while acknowledging the procurement review.
- Contingencies: fallback routing to a 2-week dedicated pilot (no billing changes) if procurement requires longer technical review; credit offer possible (TBD by Redwood leadership).

Request: can procurement review the one-page register and confirm whether the soft-accept/hard-accept split would be sufficient for their executive packet?

I copied Grace and Jordan to help surface the risk log and coordinate SOC delivery.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (proposed updated MAP), SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — commitment timing concern (internal risk notes)

Marcus / Jordan —

Quick internal risk log excerpt to include in the one-pager before we send to procurement:

1) SOC2 evidence completeness — likelihood: medium; impact: high. Mitigation: deliver summarized artifacts + signed attestation from our compliance team by 2026-09-17. Owner: Grace O'Connor.

2) Procurement legal redline on data residency clause — likelihood: low; impact: medium. Mitigation: offer a redline-backed clause for dedicated instances and a fallback to using encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys. Owner: Jordan Blake.

3) Scheduling churn (customer-side) — likelihood: high; impact: medium. Mitigation: propose a split accept (soft/hard) and a firm 7-day verification window. Owner: Marcus Lin.

Action items for external comms: remove internal estimation notes, keep only the mitigation steps and firm dates. I recommend we fast-track Laura Bennett for approval on the credit/exception ask if procurement confirms they need a stronger financial backstop.

Grace

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Rios <claudia.rios@kphealth.com>, procurement@kphealth.com
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@kphealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:00:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP v2 and one-page risk register — formal request for procurement packet inclusion

Claudia / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick review this morning. Attached is MAP_v2.xlsx and a one-page risk register (extracted from our internal risk log) that you can include in your executive packet. Key commitments:

- SOC evidence delivery: SOC2 evidence summary delivered by 2026-09-17 (we have attached the current summary; full working artifacts to follow).
- Acceptance cadence: Soft-accept (feature parity) by 2026-09-27; 7-day production verification window; hard-accept target 2026-10-04.
- Contingency: If procurement requires extended technical review beyond Oct 4, Redwood will provision a 2-week dedicated pilot window with zero incremental billing while review completes.

We also include two concrete asks for procurement:
1) Confirm whether the soft-accept/hard-accept split is acceptable for the executive packet.
2) If procurement needs a stronger financial backstop (credit or escrow), indicate that now and we will escalate for a one-time concession decision.

DocuSign link for the MAP amendment (if procurement confirms): https://www.docusign.com/packet/XYZ-8921

Quoted from Grace's internal notes (for transparency):
> SOC2 evidence completeness — mitigation: deliver summarized artifacts + signed attestation by 2026-09-17.
> Scheduling churn — mitigation: split accept and 7-day verification window; owner: Marcus Lin.

Please let us know by EOD Monday 2026-09-14 so we can lock resource schedules and compliance sign-off.

Best,
Marcus
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP v2 and one-page risk register — formal request for procurement packet inclusion

Team —

Thanks for pulling this together. I reviewed Marcus' proposal and Grace's risk notes. Approved to offer a one-time credit (0.5% of first-year committed ARR) as a contingent concession if procurement requires it to sign off on the hard-accept date.

Conditions:
- Credit is conditional upon procurement signing the MAP amendment and accepting the hard-accept verification period.
- SOC artifacts must be delivered by 2026-09-17; legal cannot accept open evidence items after the signature.
- Any additional SLA exceptions require a separate legal review and will be evaluated case-by-case.

Marcus — escalate this to procurement and include the conditional credit language in the DocuSign packet. I'll standby for the redline if legal needs to be brought in.

Laura Bennett
VP, Global Sales — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
